name: Acorn Master Compact Mouse Driver (PMFS)
description: An annotated disassembly of PMFS, the pointer and mouse driver on the Acorn BBC Master Compact Welcome disc. PMFS is a 65C02 sideways ROM image, loaded into sideways RAM, that moves a software pointer from a quadrature mouse or trackerball, an analogue or digital joystick, or the cursor keys, and reports its position through ADVAL. MOS 5 has no mouse support of its own, so PMFS is the Master Compact's mouse driver, and the interface it presents is the one Welcome-era software expects. PMFS is (C) 1986 PMF; the annotations and disassembly scripts here are (C) 2026 Acornaeology.
